data.narrative:
Epic Aerospace is a Series A-stage space and aerospace company founded by Ignacio Belieres Montero, with undisclosed prior funding from YC and Thiel. The valuation universe comprises 13 comparable companies across Space & Aerospace—5 public equities (RKLB, PL, LUNR, ASTS, SATL) and 8 private peers including SpaceX, Rocket Lab, ICEYE, Sierra Space, and Planet Labs.

Standard triangulation methods encounter material constraints here. Peer-median analysis is inapplicable: while 14 same-sector peers exist, filtering for same-stage, adjacent-stage, or similar valuation-tier companies yields fewer than three datapoints, making narrow comparables unreliable. Public-comp anchoring similarly cannot proceed—the six public Space & Aerospace comps trade at a median 26.4x price-to-sales, but Epic Aerospace's revenue is not on file, precluding P/S application. Private company revenue disclosure remains sparse, blocking extension into that universe. The data constraints are structural rather than incidental.

Without executable valuation methods, no quantitative range can be derived from this dataset. Any Series A valuation for Epic Aerospace would require either: disclosure of target revenue or profitability metrics; identification of three or more directly comparable Series A rounds in space hardware/launch; or supplementary data on fundraising terms (post-money, share price, investor lead). Current information supports only a sectoral context—that public space equities command substantial multiples—but does not support a specific valuation estimate.
